ctx.x: And having lived through all of that, and having left Dallas and went on up and down that road show, and learned that fidelity, and learned that training ground, and come back...and going to Kansas City, and going to Chicago, and going to Detroit. Then coming to New York. And from New York stretching out across the sea. Going to Europe and meeting Panassié and authorities and cardinals and vice president and president .

And having had the opportunitcy to meet people in the record industry like Al Jolson and Jack Kapp, and Bing Crosby and Ella Fitzgerald and black, great musicians like Louis Armstrong and Duke Ellington. And meeting Guy Lombardo and meeting...you name it and I've met them. From Hubert Humphrey on down to Danny Morgenstern. To do all of these things in 71 years, and to start from that humble beginning where my grandmother had them put a big pot in the back yard, three bricks high, five stacks, fill it full of hot…

Yesterday I sat here with you, and when I sat here with you yesterday I had a thousand dollars in my pocket. Today I have twenty-two dollars. This is the way...you heard my daughter ask me for a fur coat you know, yesterday. I'll give it
